# Background remover

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/background-remover/

Create a transparent cutout from a photo using local AI, or remove a connected plain-color background with a faster color-based method.

## How to use it

1. Choose a clear, supported image from your device.
2. Adjust the image settings and run the tool.
3. Inspect the preview, then download or copy the result.

## Example

Remove a product photo’s white background, then save a transparent PNG for a design.

## Limits and checks

The AI model downloads on first use. Fine hair, glass and complex scenes may need extra refinement; cutout quality varies.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Processing runs on the device; an engine or model may download from a third-party CDN. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
